name: twinbridge
description: Continue work across your two Claude accounts. Save a handoff in one, pick it up in the other, from a server you run yourself.

connector_url.description: Your handoff server's base URL, e.g. https://handoffs.example.com (no trailing slash)
connector_url.title: Handoff server URL

account_token.description: This account's token from your handoff server
account_token.title: Account token

other_config_dir.title: Other account's Claude Code folder (optional)
other_config_dir.description: The config folder of your other Claude Code profile, shown in the panel's Accounts section. Empty: ~/.claude-personal when this profile is ~/.claude, else ~/.claude
